**Finding submitted — TRANSITION: deviation (fallback target).**

- **What exists:** Section 14.3 (p0782–p0789) assigns the Trial Data Package/Research Results, transfers Product Filings, and allows continued conduct of Clinical Trials to enable transfer; Section 10.3 (p0640) covers return/destruction of Confidential Information with written certification.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** 14.3 is triggered only by a Section 14.2 termination and only if no Program Transfer occurs (so no expiry coverage); the assistance period and the delivery period are both redacted ([***]) and the delivery clock runs from Product Filing assignment rather than from expiry/termination.
- **Cure:** one insert — new Section 14.5 providing at least 90 days of transition assistance and delivery of all Clinical Trial data (including the Trial Data Package and Research Results) within 30 days of expiry or any termination. Sections 14.3 and 10.3 are left verbatim, and no preferred-only extras (6 months, then-current rates, certified deletion) were volunteered.
